name: Object-space decomposition with local clustering
definition: The k-way partitioning performed in each processor Pk effectively constitutes a K-way global clustering solution C = [C1, C2, ..., CK].
summary: Object-space decomposition with local clustering partitions unstructured grids into geometrically connected cell-clusters for parallel rendering, differing from uniform partitioning by respecting irregular connectivity and from view-dependent strategies by using static preprocessing.
